aliasesNote: Official public label is 'K2.8 Preview' (Kimi Code docs). Serving model ID on the Kimi Code subscription route is the stable alias 'kimi-for-coding', which resolved to K2.7 Code until 2026-09-11 and now serves K2.8 Preview. 'kimi-for-coding-highspeed' still serves K2.7 Code HighSpeed. No 'K2p8', 'K2.8 Code', 'K2.8 Thinking', 'K2.8 HighSpeed', 'K2.8 256K/1M', or 'K2.8 Max' product labels were seen anywhere; K2.8 Preview exposes reasoning_effort low/high/max (default max), not separate variant models. K2.8 is NOT on the pay-per-token API model list (platform.kimi.ai / platform.moonshot.cn still list only kimi-k3, kimi-k2.7-code(+highspeed), kimi-k2.6).

Alternative spelling 'kimi-k2.8-preview' if the coordinator prefers to keep the Preview suffix.

qualitativeClaims: K2.8 Preview is now fully rolled out in Kimi Code; Model ID unchanged, still `kimi-for-coding` (EN docs, verbatim).
Performance close to K3, with more efficient thinking (EN docs heading, verbatim; ZH: 综合性能接近 K3，思考效率更高).
Coding and agent capabilities are improved across the board, with significantly more efficient thinking than K2.7 Code (EN docs, verbatim).
Same thinking levels as K3: low / high / max (default max). With thinking turned off, requests to the K3 series and K2.8 Preview are served by K2.8 Preview (no thinking) (EN docs, verbatim).
A context window of up to 1M is available across all membership tiers (EN docs, verbatim).
